target_definition_audit.interpretation: Reference-local V and exact q pixel V are different targets; even a perfect target-visible mask read at q cannot automatically reproduce a reference-local V when qGT is O. Original primary labels stay unchanged. However strict535 qGT agrees with the reference labels and remains weak, so target-definition mismatch is not the whole explanation.

limits: Same four V79 outcome-cell examples, fixed before V81, are diagnostic not prevalence evidence.
Same globally fixed22-class caption for every image; no GT target class supplied, no GT candidate/mask selection.
Open-vocabulary phrase does not uniquely identify intended instance from an imprecise input q-box.
Mask0 is NOT_VISIBLE_MASK, not physical absence, causal external E or self S; U is no mask or invalid q.
Whole-instance visible-mask IoU and exact query-pixel/reference-semantic metrics are different objectives.
No current223, new training, PnP, query shift, new radius or posthoc score/threshold/model selection.
Prior failed SAM output-dtype guard and pre-run detector padded-logit guard were infrastructure contract fixes; preserved artifacts remain immutable.
